evidence.text:
License revenues increased $8.2 million , or 22.5% , to $44.8 million in 2012 from $36.6 million in 2011 . This increase in license revenues was a result of increased distribution and continued unit volume growth by our licensees. 
 Gross profit increased $166.5 million to $879.3 million in 2012 from $712.8 million in 2011. Gross profit as a percentage of net revenues, or gross margin, decreased 50 basis points to 47.9% in 2012 compared to 48.4% in 2011.
